title: Modal
description: The shared dialog: full screen on phones, a centred panel from sm up, with title, description, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener.
when: A short task that needs the user's full attention (edit settings, create an item).

instead.need: Yes / no before a destructive action
Filters or details beside the page
A short message after an action

a11y: role="dialog" + aria-modal, labelled by the title; Escape and the close button close it; focus trap and focus return built in; page scroll is locked.
